title: Physical Damage Coverage Per Vehicle and Per Owner Term
content:
A named insured may carry the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision) on any number of vehicles. There is no maximum number of coverages per named insured. There is one coverage per scheduled vehicle.

**Clause.** A vehicle carries at most one physical damage coverage per owner term. The coverage belongs to one owner term. A renewal term carries its own coverage record for each vehicle renewed with it.

### How a duplicate is recognised

The system records are authoritative here, not the caller's account. When coverage is added for a vehicle, an existing coverage record counts as the vehicle's coverage for the owner term when all three of the following hold:
- it is on the same owner term;
- it has the same VIN;
- its status is inspection pending, active or terminated.

A coverage that was removed or has expired does not count.

| Existing record for the same VIN on the same owner term | Counts as the vehicle's one coverage |
|---|---|
| Inspection pending | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| Terminated | Yes |
| Removed | No |
| Expired | No |
| None | No |

### Hypothetical cases

- A household schedules three vehicles on one owner term. Each vehicle may carry its own coverage, so three coverages in all.
- A vehicle whose coverage was removed earlier in the term may be covered again on that term. A vehicle whose coverage is terminated may not.
- When the owner term renews, each vehicle renewed with it gets its own coverage record on the renewal term.
